verses.original: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hil·lāh lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·rō·w·mim·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·w·hay ham·me·leḵ wa·’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵāh šim·k̲ā lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: [A Psalm] of praise Of David I will exalt You my God [and] King I will bless Your name forever and ever

verses.original: בְּכָל־ י֥וֹם אֲבָרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl yō·wm ’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵe·kā wa·’ă·hal·lāh šim·k̲ā lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: Every day I will bless You and I will praise Your name forever and ever

verses.original: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: gā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ ū·mə·hul·lāl wə·liḡ·ḏul·lā·ṯōw ’ên ḥê·qer
verses.literal: Great [is] the LORD and greatly to be praised His greatness vvv [is] unsearchable

verses.original: דּ֣וֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ לְ֭דוֹר יַגִּֽידוּ׃ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: dō·wr yə·šab·baḥ ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā lə·ḏō·wr yag·gî·ḏū ū·ḡə·ḇū·rō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: One generation will commend Your works to the next and will proclaim Your mighty acts

verses.original: כְּב֣וֹד הֲ֭דַר הוֹדֶ֑ךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֣יךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י
verses.transliteration: kə·ḇō·wḏ hă·ḏar hō·w·ḏe·ḵā ’ā·śî·ḥāh nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḏiḇ·rê
verses.literal: the glorious splendor of Your majesty And I will meditate on Your wondrous works

verses.original: יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וֶעֱז֣וּז נוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃ וּגְדוּלֹּתֶיךָ
verses.transliteration: yō·mê·rū we·‘ĕ·zūz nō·wr·’ō·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·sap·pə·ren·nāh ū·ḡə·ḏūl·lō·ṯɛ·ḵå̄
verses.literal: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds and I will declare Your greatness

verses.original: יַבִּ֑יעוּ זֵ֣כֶר רַב־ טוּבְךָ֣ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: yab·bî·‘ū zê·ḵer raḇ- ṭū·ḇə·ḵā yə·ran·nê·nū wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā
verses.literal: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness

verses.original: יְהוָ֑ה חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדָל־ חָֽסֶד׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ḥan·nūn wə·ra·ḥūm ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim ū·ḡə·ḏāl- ḥā·seḏ
verses.literal: The LORD is gracious and compassionate slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה טוֹב־ לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־ כָּל־ מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṭō·wḇ- lak·kōl wə·ra·ḥă·māw ‘al- kāl- ma·‘ă·śāw
verses.literal: The LORD is good to all His compassion rests on all He has made

verses.original: כָּל־ מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרֲכֽוּכָה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā yō·w·ḏū·ḵā Yah·weh wa·ḥă·sî·ḏe·ḵā yə·ḇā·ră·ḵū·ḵāh
verses.literal: All You have made will give You thanks O LORD and Your saints will bless You

verses.original: יֹאמֵ֑רוּ כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: yō·mê·rū kə·ḇō·wḏ mal·ḵū·ṯə·ḵā yə·ḏab·bê·rū ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯə·ḵā
verses.literal: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might

verses.original: לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ׀ לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hō·w·ḏî·a‘ liḇ·nê hā·’ā·ḏām gə·ḇū·rō·ṯāw ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ hă·ḏar mal·ḵū·ṯōw
verses.literal: to make known vvv to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom

verses.original: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ כָּל־ עֹֽלָמִ֑ים מַלְכ֥וּת וּ֝מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכָל־ דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: mal·ḵū·ṯə·ḵā kāl- ‘ō·lā·mîm mal·ḵūṯ ū·mem·šel·tə·ḵā bə·ḵāl dō·wr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal:
Your kingdom vvv is an everlasting kingdom and Your dominion [endures] through all generations The LORD is faithful in all His words

and kind in all His actions

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה סוֹמֵ֣ךְ לְכָל־ הַנֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝זוֹקֵ֗ף לְכָל־ הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh sō·w·mêḵ lə·ḵāl han·nō·p̄ə·lîm wə·zō·w·qêp̄ lə·ḵāl hak·kə·p̄ū·p̄îm
verses.literal: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down

verses.original: עֵֽינֵי־ כֹ֭ל יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ אֵלֶ֣יךָ וְאַתָּ֤ה נֽוֹתֵן־ לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־ אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nê- ḵōl yə·śab·bê·rū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’at·tāh nō·w·ṯên- lā·hem ’eṯ- ’ā·ḵə·lām bə·‘it·tōw
verses.literal: The eyes of all look to You and You give . . . them their food in season

verses.original: פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־ יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ רָצֽוֹן׃ לְכָל־ חַ֣י
verses.transliteration: pō·w·ṯê·aḥ ’eṯ- yā·ḏe·ḵā ū·maś·bî·a‘ rā·ṣō·wn lə·ḵāl ḥay
verses.literal: You open - Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה צַדִּ֣יק בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָ֑יו וְ֝חָסִ֗יד בְּכָל־ מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣad·dîq bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw wə·ḥā·sîḏ bə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śāw
verses.literal: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה קָר֣וֹב לְכָל־ קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh qā·rō·wḇ lə·ḵāl qō·rə·’āw lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yiq·rā·’u·hū ḇe·’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: The LORD is near to all who call on Him to all who call out to Him in truth

verses.original: יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽאֶת־ רְצוֹן־ יְרֵאָ֥יו יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע שַׁוְעָתָ֥ם וְיוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·śeh wə·’eṯ- rə·ṣō·wn- yə·rê·’āw yiš·ma‘ šaw·‘ā·ṯām wə·yō·wō·šî·‘êm
verses.literal: He fulfills - the desires of those who fear Him He hears their cry and saves them

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר כָּל־ אֹהֲבָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָרְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- šō·w·mêr kāl- ’ō·hă·ḇāw wə·’êṯ kāl- hā·rə·šā·‘îm yaš·mîḏ
verses.literal: The LORD - preserves all who love Him but all the wicked He will destroy

verses.original: פִּ֥י יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר־ תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה כָּל־ בָּ֭שָׂר וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ קָדְשׁ֗וֹ שֵׁ֥ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: pî yə·ḏab·ber- tə·hil·laṯ Yah·weh kāl- bā·śār wî·ḇā·rêḵ qā·ḏə·šōw šêm lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever
